# abcd-banlist: keyed
# abcd-banlist-example
# Fixture banlist — a KEYED store whose header repeats the format declaration
# below line 1. The declaration is only ever read from line 1, so a second one is
# an edit that moved or duplicated it, and BOTH readers must refuse the file by
# line number rather than one calling it healthy while the other blocks every
# commit. Values are reserved-documentation or persona-derived only.
# abcd-banlist: keyed

lab-host         alice-laptop\.example\.com
